am.opt.alwaysDesc: Asks before every command, file change, web request that changes something and computer action. Nothing you allowed earlier answers for you.
am.opt.defaultDesc: Default. Asks when an action needs you. What you allow in this chat, your rules and your hooks can let actions run without asking.
am.opt.everythingDesc: Allows actions without asking in this chat until you switch it off or the Agent restarts. Deny rules still win; questions, hooks that ask and tool servers that confirm still wait for you.
am.why.locked: Set by this computer's policy, so it can't be changed here.
am.why.unknown: This chat's approvals couldn't be read, so they can't be changed here.
am.why.wait: Another change to this chat is being saved or checked. Choose again when it is done.
am.why.noRevision: This computer's agent didn't say which version of the approvals it holds, so they can't be changed here.
am.why.busy: The Agent is working or waiting for you. Change this when the reply ends.
am.why.strictFirst: Choose Ask when needed first. Ask every time allows nothing automatically.
am.why.notHere: Allow everything can't be switched from this view. Open the chat to switch it.
am.confirmBody: The Agent on {{computer}} will run every action in this chat without asking you first, as you: commands, file changes and deletions, and some actions normally kept for a person.
am.confirm.waiting: An approval that is waiting now is allowed at once.
am.confirm.keeps: Deny rules still win. Questions, hooks that ask and connected tool servers that confirm each call still wait for you.
am.confirm.until: It stays on for this chat only, until you switch it off or the Agent on {{computer}} restarts.
am.done.everything: Allow everything is on for this chat. Actions run without asking you first; questions, hooks that ask and tool servers that confirm still wait for you.
am.done.asks: This chat asks when needed again.
am.done.always: This chat now asks every time.
am.done.default: This chat now asks when needed.
am.maybe: The change to approvals may have gone through.
am.conflict: The approvals changed meanwhile, so nothing was changed. Choose again.
am.refused: This computer's policy refused the change. Nothing was changed.
am.failed: The approvals could not be changed. Nothing was changed.
am.failedOn: Allow everything could not be turned on. This chat still asks when needed.
am.failedOff: Allow everything could not be turned off. Check the approvals again.
am.unsentOn: Allow everything was not turned on. Nothing was sent.
am.unsentOff: Allow everything was not turned off. Nothing was sent.
am.card.session.bash: Allow for this session: every later command in this chat runs without asking.
am.card.session.action: Allow for this session: later {{tool}} actions of this kind run in this chat without asking.
am.card.session.tool: Allow for this session: every later {{tool}} call in this chat runs without asking.
